extracted.name: Avocado Breakfast Bowl
extracted.description: Quinoa, eggs, avocado, and feta cheese are layered together in this quick and easy avocado breakfast bowl.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir water and quinoa together in a rice cooker; cook until quinoa is tender, about 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook eggs to desired doneness; season with seasoned salt and pepper.
Combine quinoa and eggs in a bowl; top with avocado and feta cheese.
